comment: What tools/image/smoke.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the bin (its log topic), a command that makes one request, the exit code of a network error, the mock's answer to that request (by path, under --base-url http://mock:8080; recorded live 2026-11-20 as GENESIS's guest user and cut to the tables), and a string the printed answer contains. The command searches as the guest user (--guest), so it needs no login. authToken: the MCP server serves HTTP only with a bearer token (it uses a personal account), so its HTTP checks get a token file.
